ir.name: ref_all_pairs_builder
ir.intuition: Reference builder: all winner/loser pairs by objective ordering.

ir.name: loss_inv_regret_softmax_safe
ir.intuition: Inverse regret weighted softmax loss that applies numeric clamping to stabilize computation and avoid infinite losses, focusing on pairs with uncertain regret.
ir.pseudocode:
eps = 1e-8
inv_regret_weight = 1 / (abs(delta_regret) + eps)
logits = stack(log_prob_w, log_prob_l)  # shape (2, batch_size)
max_logits = max(logits, axis=0)
stable_logits = logits - max_logits
exp_logits = exp(stable_logits)
sum_exp = sum(exp_logits, axis=0)
softmax_scores = exp_logits / sum_exp
log_softmax_w = log(softmax_scores[0].clamp(min=eps))
loss_per_pair = -inv_regret_weight * log_softmax_w * weight
return mean(loss_per_pair)
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    eps = 1e-8
    lpw = batch["log_prob_w"]
    lpl = batch["log_prob_l"]
    weight = batch.get("weight", ops.ones_like(lpw))
    delta_regret = batch["delta_regret"]
    inv_regret_weight = ops.div(ops.ones_like(delta_regret), ops.add(ops.abs(delta_regret), eps))
    logits = ops.stack([lpw, lpl])  # shape (2, batch_size)
    max_logits = logits.max(dim=0)[0]
    stable_logits = ops.sub(logits, max_logits)
    exp_logits = ops.exp(stable_logits)
    sum_exp = ops.sum(exp_logits, 0)
    softmax_scores = ops.div(exp_logits, sum_exp.clamp(min=eps))
    log_softmax_w = ops.log(softmax_scores[0].clamp(min=eps))
    loss_per_pair = ops.mul(ops.mul(inv_regret_weight, weight), ops.neg(log_softmax_w))
    return ops.mean(loss_per_pair)
